name: 双尾飞行落点预留
description: 预留落点在搬运结算前不可进入。
skillCode: var effects=battle.extensions&&battle.extensions.tileEffects||[];var reserved=effects.some(function(e){return e.type==='tails-flight-reservation'&&e.x===context.targetX&&e.y===context.targetY;});if(reserved)return {success:true,blocked:true,message:'该地格已被双尾飞行预留'};return {success:false,message:''};
